data_sources.asd: UCI ML Repository (Adults id=426, Children id=419) CC BY 4.0
data_sources.adhd: WHO ASRS-v1.1 published norms (Kessler et al. 2005) + Conners-3 norming study (N=3400)
data_sources.dyslexia: IDA/Yale cohort published distributions (Shaywitz 1990) + CTOPP-2 norms
data_sources.dld: Tomblin et al. 1997 Iowa epidemiological study + CELF-5 norming (Wiig et al. 2013, N=2725)
data_sources.tourette: YGTSS validation cohort (Leckman et al. 1989, N=135) + PUTS norms (Woods et al. 2005)

augmentation_note: Base records seeded from published clinical distributions. Augmented to 3100+ using per-feature Bernoulli/Beta sampling. All synthetic records labelled data_source=synthetic_from_published.
